EmailTemplate.name: Application Received
EmailTemplate.subject: Applicant Engagement
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {{{Recipient.FirstName}}},
Thank you for applying to the K9 Detection Program. We are excited to help you begin your journey toward certification and employment within the K9 industry.
Your application has been received and is currently being reviewed. Over the next several days, a member of our team will contact you to discuss your goals, answer questions, and walk you through the next steps in the enrollment process.
If you have any immediate questions, please feel free to reply to this email or contact us directly.
We look forward to speaking with you soon.
Best regards,
The AK9I Team
American K-9 Interdiction
enrollment@ak9i.com
(757) 304 - 9600
